remarks: Welcome home to this beautifully maintained condominium in coveted Graystone! Offering the perfect blend of space, comfort, and an unbeatable prized in-town location, this is the one. This bright and spacious residence features hardwood floors throughout, three generously sized bedrooms, all thoughtfully situated on one level, along with three full bathrooms. The home is ideal for both everyday living and effortless entertaining.The renovated and expansive kitchen is warm and inviting, complete with a large bow window dining area- ideal for morning coffee or casual meals. A sun-filled family room highlighted by four skylights, complemented by the living and formal dining areas, offers versatile spaces for both relaxation and entertaining. The large unfinished lower level offers additional possibilities, perfect for a home office, gym, or recreation area. Step outside to your own private, fully fenced stone patio, a peaceful retreat for outdoor enjoyment. An attached one-car garage offers convenient year-round access, while second-level laundry adds everyday ease. Set within a beautifully maintained condominium community, this home places you just steps from the best of New Canaan's downtown living-dining, shopping, parks and more. Move right-in to this delightful unit, and enjoy this easy lifestyle.
